description: Lifecycle contract and evidence checklist; phase criteria do not imply execution

criteria: Stakeholders and problem evidence recorded
Hypotheses and alternatives documented
Uncertainties and acceptance owner identified

phases.purpose: Specify verifiable functional and non-functional needs
criteria: User-visible behavior and failure paths specified
Acceptance criteria traceable to requirements
Security, reliability and privacy constraints considered

phases.purpose: Make justified and reversible technical decisions
criteria: As-Is boundaries and relevant integration contracts mapped
ADR with alternatives and tradeoffs reviewed
To-Be justified with constraints, risks and rollback

phases.purpose: Design usable and accessible user interactions
criteria: Target user journeys and interaction failures assessed
Accessibility requirements and keyboard interaction checked
Responsive behavior and error states validated
Affected execution boundaries enumerated
Positive and negative paths verified
Changes limited to authorized scope
Contract/version compatibility assessed
Timeout, retry and idempotency behavior evaluated
Authentication and failure paths verified

phases.purpose: Protect integrity and lifecycle of information
criteria: Data invariants and migration impact reviewed
Backup, retention and rollback documented
Sensitive fields and access boundaries evaluated
Appropriate tests actually executed
Independent review findings disposition recorded
Unverified behavior and residual risks stated

phases.purpose: Prepare traceable deployment or release proposal
criteria: Build and immutable artifact identified
Rollout, rollback and security gates documented
Authorized human release decision recorded separately
SLO and alert thresholds documented where applicable
Incident runbook and escalation owners identified
Restore/recovery exercise results or limitations recorded
Backward compatibility and consumers assessed
Regression results available
Deprecation and cost tradeoffs documented
Consumers and dependent integrations notified
Retention, export and disposal requirements recorded
Authorized retirement and recovery plan documented
